newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGYPT POUND FALLS AGAINST DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: EGYPT POUND FALLS AGAINST DOLLAR.

text.p: The Egyptian pound fell against the dollar in the private sector market on Tuesday despite a slight shortage in the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"There is still a bit of a shortage in dollars that was created by demand by some banks," said one banker.
Five actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3900 and 3.3950 pounds bid and 3.3910 and 3.3970 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average exchange rate was 3.3935 bid and 3.3950 offered, compared to 3.3921 bid and 3.3937 offered on Monday.
The central bank calculated the average rate at midday at 3.388144 pounds buy and 3.393813 pounds sell.
